title: TypeScript SDK: streaming-first typegen + Zod/JSON‑Schema bridge for discriminated unions
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Background: Teams building streaming integrations with the TypeScript SDK struggle to bridge compile-time discriminated unions with runtime validation when models stream partial JSON shapes. This ticket implements a streaming-first type generation flow that produces both TypeScript discriminated unions and companion Zod/JSON‑Schema validators, plus ergonomic helpers for incremental parsing of streaming chunks and examples for common patterns. Goals: (1) reduce runtime type errors and surprises when decoding streamed structured output; (2) provide a single ergonomic consumption surface for sync/async and streaming results; (3) output human-friendly examples and migration docs for existing customers.
acceptance_criteria: typegen CLI emits: .d.ts file with discriminated unions and a parallel zod module (.z.ts) for every model output schema
generated Zod validators accept partial streamed payloads via `z.object().partial()`-aware helpers and expose `mergeChunk()` utilities for incremental parsing
JSON‑Schema artifacts are emitted and validated against our internal conformance tests (roundtrip <= 0 failures across 50 synthetic prompts)

SDK runtime exposes `streamAs<T>(schemaRef, options)` that returns an async iterator of `T | Partial<T>` and a `finalize()` helper that validates merged output and returns `T` or throws a structured ValidationError
migration guide and three examples added: streaming chat commands (discriminated union of Action/Message), long-form citation extraction, and embeddings metadata extraction
end-to-end tests in CI that simulate tokenized partial JSON chunks and assert no spurious parser crashes and correct final validated object
technical_notes: Typegen approach: analyze supplied JSON Schema -> produce TypeScript discriminated union types and a parallel Zod module using `z.discriminatedUnion()` where applicable
Streaming parsing: adopt a small incremental JSON frame parser that buffers key/value fragments and emits stable partial objects; helper exposes `mergeChunk(prev, chunk)` semantics
Error model: ValidationError includes `path` and `recovery_hint`; finalizer will include original raw stream for replay in logs
Codegen output layout: `<model>.types.d.ts`, `<model>.validators.z.ts`, `<model>.schema.json` under `generated/` with source-map backrefs to original schema
Backward-compat: existing `parseStream` usages remain but will be shimmed to call `streamAs` with a deprecation warning

Performance: minimize runtime allocations by reusing shape buffers and precompiled Zod validators; benchmark target: <= 5% overhead vs current naive JSON.parse streaming path for 90th percentile payload
decisions: Choose Zod as the first-class runtime validator for DX and ecosystem familiarity; emit JSON‑Schema for interop and server-side checks
Generate `z.discriminatedUnion()` where direct tag exists; fall back to union-of-guards for complex discriminators
Expose both incremental validator helpers and a strict final validation step to keep streaming low-latency while ensuring final correctness
